focus: 把「不行」翻譯成「這是交換條件」
lead: 被臨時插件時，多數人只有兩個反應：硬吞下來，或說 “I don't have time”。前者你之後會爆炸，後者聽起來像抱怨。今天練的是不否定目標，只把成本攤開讓對方選——你不是在拒絕，你是在讓對方做他該做的取捨。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Help me understand what breaks if this waits two weeks.
phrases.gl: 讓我了解一下，如果這件事晚兩週，會壞掉什麼（先問後果，不要先問理由——問理由像在質疑人，問後果是在做判斷）
phrases.ex: Before I move anything around — help me understand what breaks if this waits two weeks.

phrases.en: I can do that, but something has to come off the list.
phrases.gl: 我可以做，但清單上得拿掉一件事（不是拒絕，是要求對方一起承擔取捨）
phrases.ex: I can do that, but something has to come off the list — right now that list is the calibration report and the November data plan.
phrases.fix: 取代 “I'm too busy, I don't have time for this”

phrases.en: That's a yes to the goal, not to the date.
phrases.gl: 我同意這個目標，但不同意這個日期（把「要不要做」和「什麼時候做」拆開，是所有 pushback 的核心動作）
phrases.ex: I want the customer to see sentry mode too — so that's a yes to the goal, not to the date.

phrases.en: Let me show you the trade, then you pick.
phrases.gl: 我把選項攤給你看，你來選（把決定權還給對方，你只負責讓成本透明）
phrases.ex: I've got two options and neither one is free. Let me show you the trade, then you pick.

phrases.en: What would 'good enough' look like on the twentieth?
phrases.gl: 在二十號那天，「夠用」長什麼樣子？（把模糊的期待逼成具體畫面，通常對方要的比你想的少很多）
phrases.ex: I don't think we can get the full pipeline running. What would 'good enough' look like on the twentieth — a live demo, or a recorded one?

phrases.en: I'd rather ship half of this properly than all of it badly.
phrases.gl: 我寧願把一半做好，也不要整包做爛（一句話講清楚你的品質底線，而且聽起來是為專案好，不是為自己輕鬆）
phrases.ex: With three weeks I'd rather ship half of this properly than all of it badly — a demo that crashes in front of the customer costs us more than a smaller demo.

phrases.en: Who else is depending on that date?
phrases.gl: 還有誰在等這個日期？（往上探一層，很多「死線」其實是別人的猜測）
phrases.ex: Before I commit — who else is depending on that date? If it's just the visit agenda, we may have more room than we think.

phrases.en: I'm not saying no. I'm saying not without dropping X.
phrases.gl: 我不是說不行，我是說「不放掉 X 就不行」（把拒絕變成條件句，語氣完全不同）
phrases.ex: I'm not saying no. I'm saying not without dropping the multi-camera fusion piece — that's the part that needs four weeks of tuning.

phrases.en: Let me write down what we just agreed and send it tonight.
phrases.gl: 我把剛剛談定的寫下來，今晚寄出（口頭的取捨隔天就會被忘記，你負責留下白紙黑字）
phrases.ex: Good — let me write down what we just agreed and send it tonight, so nobody remembers this differently on Monday.

setup: Setup. Thursday, four p.m. David walks over: a customer delegation moved their visit up to September 20th, seventeen days from now, and he'd like the sentry-mode demo on the agenda. Your current plan has sentry mode in a lab-only state by mid-October: the Orin box records fine, but the event-trigger logic still throws false positives on shadows and passing cyclists, roughly one false alert every four minutes. Two things are already on your plate for the same window: the sensor-calibration report Ryan needs for the November data collection plan, and the SRDC v0.0.2 format sign-off that three teams are waiting on. You have one engineer, and he's on annual leave next week. David isn't unreasonable, but he responds badly to “that's not possible” and very well to numbers.

prompts.q: David: “Customer visit moved to the 20th. Can we put sentry mode on the agenda?”
prompts.frame: 先問後果、不要先辯解 → 說出你同意的部分 → 攤開現況的數字 → 給兩個選項讓他選。
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 50 秒）。第一句不准是 “Actually we cannot...”，第一句必須是一個問句。
prompts.model: “Help me understand what breaks if sentry mode isn't on that agenda — is the visit built around it, or is it one item of six? … Okay. Then that's a yes to the goal, not to the date. Here's where we actually are: the box records reliably, but the event trigger fires a false alert roughly every four minutes on shadows and cyclists. In front of a customer, that's not a demo, that's an apology. And my engineer is on leave next week, so I've got about eight working days, not seventeen. So let me show you the trade, then you pick. Option one, we demo live but only the recording and playback path, no auto-trigger — that I can make solid. Option two, we show a two-minute recorded clip of the full trigger flow from last week's best run, and I tell the customer honestly it's still in tuning. What I can't do is a live auto-trigger on the 20th.”

prompts.q: David: “Can't you just tighten the threshold so it stops firing on shadows? That's a one-line change.”
prompts.frame: 不要說 “it's not that simple” → 承認那確實是一行 → 說出那一行的代價 → 給一個可驗證的小實驗和回報時間。
prompts.say: 出聲練習「技術上的婉拒」——重點是把抽象的困難換成具體的副作用，而不是說對方不懂。
prompts.model: “You're right that it's one line — the problem is what that line costs. If I raise the threshold high enough to ignore shadows, it also ignores a person walking past at night, which is the exact case the customer cares about. Right now we're trading false alarms against missed events, and we haven't measured that curve yet. So here's what I'll do: I'll run the threshold across five settings on last month's night footage and get you the numbers — how many false alerts, how many real events missed at each one. That's a day of compute, no engineer time. You'll have it Monday morning, and then we decide the 20th with data instead of hoping. If the curve looks good, I'll happily be wrong about this.”

prompts.q: David: “Fine. But I still need the calibration report and the format sign-off on time. Those can't slip.”
prompts.frame: 不要含糊答應三件事 → 明講產能上限 → 提出最小的求援 → 用書面收尾。
prompts.say: 出聲練習「不加班承諾」。禁止出現 “I will try my best” 和 “I will find a way”。
prompts.model: “Then I need to be straight with you: three things, eight working days, one engineer on leave — I can do two of them properly. I'm not saying no. I'm saying not without dropping something or getting help. My proposal: the format sign-off stays, because three teams are blocked on it and it's mostly review time from me. The calibration report is the one I'd move — Ryan needs it for the November plan, and November doesn't start for eight weeks, so a five-day slip costs him nothing if I tell him today. Alternatively, if you can lend me two days of Ivy's time for the report, nothing slips at all. Your call — but I'd rather you choose now than find out in two weeks. Let me write down what we agree and send it tonight.”

fixes.bad: I have no time to do this, my schedule is very tight.
fixes.good: I can take this on, but the calibration report moves to next week. Which one do you want first?
fixes.note: Framing（框架）：no time 是在講你的困難，對方只會覺得你在抱怨；講「交換條件」是在講他的選擇，他就得負責。英文職場的 pushback 幾乎都是這個句型：yes, and here's the cost。

fixes.bad: This is impossible to finish before 20th September.
fixes.good: I can't get the live auto-trigger working by the 20th. I can get the playback path working by the 20th.
fixes.note: Precision（精準度）：impossible 太大、太容易被挑戰，而且聽起來像情緒。把不行的範圍縮到最小、同時說出你可以的部分，你的「不行」才有可信度。

fixes.bad: I think maybe we can try to do a part of it, if possible.
fixes.good: We can do the playback path. Not the auto-trigger.
fixes.note: Hedging（過度緩衝）：I think / maybe / try / if possible 四個緩衝詞疊在一起，聽者接收到的訊息是「他自己也不知道」。英文會議裡，緩衝詞越多，你的專業感掉得越快——一句話最多一個。

fixes.bad: The false alert is happen every four minutes.
fixes.good: We get a false alert about every four minutes.
fixes.note: Grammar（時態結構）：is happen 是把 be 動詞和原形動詞硬接在一起。要嘛 it happens（現在式），要嘛 it's happening（進行式）。口語上更自然的講法是把主詞換成 we：we get a false alert…

fixes.bad: Please help me to confirm this with Ryan until Friday.
fixes.good: Could you confirm this with Ryan by Friday?
fixes.note: Preposition（介系詞）：until 是「持續到」，by 才是「在……之前完成」。until Friday 聽起來像要對方確認到週五為止。另外 help me to confirm 是中式英文，直接請對方做就好。

challenge:
今天遇到任何插件需求時，做這一件事：不要回答 yes 或 no，先問後果、再攤成本 ——

“Help me understand what breaks if this waits ___. … That's a yes to the goal, not to the date. I can do that, but ___ has to come off the list.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：挑一件你這週「其實不該答應但答應了」的事，重講一次。

  • 第一句必須是問句，不能是解釋
  • 中段要出現一個具體數字（天數、次數、百分比）
  • 結尾給對方兩個選項，不要只給一個
  • 禁用：I don't have time、impossible、I will try my best、maybe we can try、until Friday
check: 今天有沒有哪一次，我在還沒問清楚後果之前就先答應或先拒絕了？
我講「做不到」的時候，有沒有同時講出「我做得到什麼」？
我把取捨留在口頭上，還是有寫下來寄出去？
